correctness.rationale: The count generator is the standard four-rate K_(m,n) zealot model; stationary first moments from Lp=q-p+(1-q)/m and Lq=p-q-p/n give Ep=n/(m+n-1), Eq=(n-1)/(m+n-1). Stationary E(p-q)^2=O(1/m+1/n) synchronizes the two part fractions. Rescaled generator converges to (theta-x)f'(x)+x(1-x)f''(x)/2; polynomial moments recur μ_k=(2theta+k-1)μ_(k-1)/(k+1), uniquely giving Beta(2theta,2-2theta) as m,n→∞ at interior ratio. The proof accommodates the transient corner and boundary cases; earlier stronger full derivation independently verifies same generator and joint limit. Finite checks are not used as an infinite convergence proof.
